first.raw_text:
Internal Revenue Service - Collections Unit

FINAL NOTICE BEFORE ARREST

You owe $486.00 in unpaid taxes.
A warrant will be issued today unless you pay immediately.

Buy gift cards for the full amount at any store and
call Officer Blake at 900-555-0171 with the card numbers.

Do not contact a lawyer. Do not hang up.
